title: Stalker monster state machine
desc: Backrooms entity with IDLE/STALK/FLEE/CHASE states: hears players in a radius, hides behind cover found by raycast sampling, peeks, flees when looked at (dot-product + raycast), sometimes snaps into a chase and plays a jumpscare kill.

title: Anchored-NPC pathfinding module
desc: Reusable module that moves anchored (non-Humanoid) NPC models along PathfindingService waypoints with ground-snapping raycasts, smooth turning, and a chase() loop that re-paths on a timer or when the target moves.

title: Zombie chase / wander AI
desc: Classic per-zombie Script: finds the nearest player on the 'Alive' team, pathfinds toward them, wanders randomly when no one is near, and deals touch damage with a per-victim cooldown.

title: Wave-based zombie round loop
desc: Wave spawner: zombies per wave = base * wave * multiplier, a timed spawn loop over tagged Spawner parts, and a round loop that advances the wave when all zombies die, ends in victory on the last wave or defeat when no players are alive.

title: Alive-enemy registry
desc: Small module that registers / unregisters spawned zombies, prunes destroyed ones and pushes the 'enemies left' count to clients.

title: Blind 'Figure' hunter (hears movement)
desc: DOORS-style Figure: patrols a Nodes folder, but while 'blind' only targets players moving faster than a speed threshold (hearing); uses direct movement when it has line of sight and pathfinding otherwise; grab-and-kill on touch; crucifix check.

title: Rush entity room sweep
desc: DOORS-style Rush: flickers lights, spawns a few rooms behind the players, then lerps the entity through each room's RoomStart->RoomEnd pathfinding waypoints at a fixed speed and awards a survival badge; supports crucifix cancel.

title: Room path-node generator
desc: Computes a path from a room's RoomStart to RoomEnd once and stores the waypoints as numbered invisible parts (PathNodes) so entities can follow them later.

title: Configurable patrol / attack bot
desc: Admin-system bot brain driven by a props table (Target, Swarm, PatrolZone, PatrolDist, Damage, team friendliness) set through a BindableEvent; patrols random points, targets the nearest valid model, walks straight when it can see the goal and pathfinds otherwise, with a forward-ray jump check.

title: Soldier AI with perception meter
desc: ACS-gun enemy soldier: patrol / chase / memory modes, a perception value that fills while the player is visible before it starts shooting, memory that decays when sight is lost, walk speeds per state, spread, and armour-aware damage. (Same script is reused for CQC/HMG/Sniper with different settings.)

title: Zone guardian boss (steal-and-run chaser)
desc: Giant guardian per egg zone: wanders its zone, chases any player carrying an egg from it with a wind-up, target-leading (aims where the player will be), speed matched to the zone's recommended speed, safe-zone wall, leash/give-up rules, knock-back on hit and fast return home. Physics driven by LinearVelocity + AlignOrientation. Comments are in French.

title: Two-phase arena boss with minions
desc: Server-authoritative boss fight: HP pool, timed ground-slam shockwave you must jump, teleports, and below 50% HP a phase 2 that spawns exploding dog minions that chase the nearest player on a fuse timer. Visuals are driven by attributes / a client FX remote. Comments are in French.

title: Wandering swarm event
desc: Timed event that spawns 20-30 small NPCs at wander points, moves each with SimplePath (path Costs avoid water/lava), picks a new random point after Reached, swaps idle/walk animations from Humanoid.Running, and scans a box around each NPC to apply a trait to nearby targets.

title: Lightweight wander runtime
desc: Tiny module that registers rigs and, every 5 seconds per rig, MoveTo's a random point 10-20 studs away; one Heartbeat connection per rig with Disconnect / DisconnectAll.

title: NPC dialogue module (typewriter + choices)
desc: Client OOP dialogue: list of {text, responses} where a response can jump to another entry (next) or close with an exit quip; typewriter text with tick sound, NPC turns to face the player, optional camera part lock, 1/2 keyboard shortcuts, hides other players, closes when you walk away.

title: Clickable-bubble NPC conversation (client)
desc: Speech bubbles over NPC heads that start a server-driven conversation; server sends choices, client shows up to 5 response buttons, ends the chat if the player walks more than 30 studs away or another player is already talking to that NPC; gamepad support.

title: Visitor / customer queue NPCs
desc: Service that spawns visitor NPCs (unique or generic), walks them through the front door to a counter with pathfinding + MoveTo timeouts, uses a collision group so they pass through doors, seats them in a waiting room (claim chair, sit pose), then leaves and despawns. Comments are in Spanish.

title: Ambient NPCs that fill seats
desc: Keeps a global NPC count under a limit by picking random free stools at casino games (priority games first), spawning an avatar NPC on the seat with sit animation, nametag and a per-NPC play script.

title: Idle NPC that looks at and waves to you
desc: Client script for NPCs tagged 'LookAtNpc': breathing idle via Motor6D C0 offsets, head + waist turn toward the local player (clamped yaw/pitch, smoothed), one wave when you come close, re-greets after you leave. Comments are in French.

title: Companion follower
desc: Buddy NPC that MoveTo's just behind its owner when further than 3.4 studs, teleports behind them past 21.5 studs, jumps when the owner jumps (remote) and cleans itself up when the owner dies or leaves.

title: Humanoid path follower
desc: Clean module: follows PathfindingService waypoints with timeouts, stuck detection, Blocked re-path, line-of-sight check and a Chase() that re-paths on interval or target movement.

title: Monster chaser brain
desc: Clean PATROL/CHASE/SEARCH/RETURN state machine with sight cone, hearing of fast-moving players, perception meter, memory, leash and melee attack.

title: Enemy wave spawner
desc: Clean server wave runner: per-wave enemy budget, batched spawns at tagged points, max-alive cap, signals for wave start / enemy died / wave cleared.

title: Server-side NPC dialogue tree
desc: Clean data-driven dialogue: nodes with choices, conditions, server actions and next jumps; validates the client's choice index and distance.
